public class FileSyncExample
{
    public async Task RunFileSyncSystemAsync()
    {
        var syncSystem = new HighAvailabilityFileSyncSystem();

        // 進捗監視
        syncSystem.OnSyncProgress += async args =>
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"同期進捗: {args.Status} - {args.OperationType} - {Path.GetFileName(args.SourcePath)}");
        };

        // 競合解決
        syncSystem.OnConflictDetected += async args =>
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"競合検出: {args.ConflictType} - {args.SourcePath}");
            Console.WriteLine($"  ソース更新: {args.SourceLastModified}");
            Console.WriteLine($"  ターゲット更新: {args.TargetLastModified}");

            // より新しいファイルを優先
            return args.SourceLastModified > args.TargetLastModified 
                ? ConflictResolution.OverwriteTarget 
                : ConflictResolution.Skip;
        };

        var config = new SyncConfiguration
        {
            SyncPairs = new List<SyncPair>
            {
                new SyncPair { SourcePath = @"C:\Source", TargetPath = @"C:\Target" }
            },
            WorkerCount = 2
        };

        var result = await syncSystem.StartSyncAsync(config);

        if (result.IsSuccess)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("ファイル同期システムが開始されました");
            Console.WriteLine("Enterキーで停止します...");
            Console.ReadLine();

            await syncSystem.StopAsync();
        }
        else
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"同期システム開始エラー: {result.ErrorMessage}");
        }

        syncSystem.Dispose();
    }
}

docs.title: 1.1 中級からの発展：複雑なクエリ構築
docs.text:
中級で学んだ基本的なLINQ操作を組み合わせて、より複雑で実用的なクエリを構築します。

public class AdvancedLinqBasics
{
    public class Employee
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public string Name { get; set; }
        public string Department { get; set; }
        public decimal Salary { get; set; }
        public DateTime HireDate { get; set; }
        public int Age { get; set; }
        public string Position { get; set; }
        public List<string> Skills { get; set; } = new List<string>();
        public Employee Manager { get; set; }
        public List<Employee> DirectReports { get; set; } = new List<Employee>();
    }

    public class Project
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public string Name { get; set; }
        public DateTime StartDate { get; set; }
        public DateTime? EndDate { get; set; }
        public decimal Budget { get; set; }
        public string Status { get; set; }
        public List<int> AssignedEmployeeIds { get; set; } = new List<int>();
    }

    private List<Employee> employees;
    private List<Project> projects;

    public AdvancedLinqBasics()
    {
        InitializeData();
    }

    private void InitializeData()
    {
        employees = new List<Employee>
        {
            new Employee { Id = 1, Name = "田中太郎", Department = "開発", Salary = 800000, Age = 35, Position = "マネージャー", HireDate = new DateTime(2018, 4, 1), Skills = new List<string> {"C#", "Azure", "リーダーシップ"} },
            new Employee { Id = 2, Name = "佐藤花子", Department = "開発", Salary = 600000, Age = 28, Position = "シニアエンジニア", HireDate = new DateTime(2020, 7, 15), Skills = new List<string> {"C#", "JavaScript", "React"} },
            new Employee { Id = 3, Name = "鈴木次郎", Department = "開発", Salary = 550000, Age = 26, Position = "エンジニア", HireDate = new DateTime(2022, 1, 10), Skills = new List<string> {"Python", "AI", "機械学習"} },
            new Employee { Id = 4, Name = "高橋美咲", Department = "QA", Salary = 520000, Age = 30, Position = "QAリード", HireDate = new DateTime(2019, 8, 20), Skills = new List<string> {"テスト自動化", "Selenium", "品質管理"} },
            new Employee { Id = 5, Name = "山田健一", Department = "営業", Salary = 700000, Age = 32, Position = "営業課長", HireDate = new DateTime(2017, 3, 1), Skills = new List<string> {"営業戦略", "顧客管理", "プレゼンテーション"} },
            new Employee { Id = 6, Name = "中村李花", Department = "人事", Salary = 480000, Age = 27, Position = "人事担当", HireDate = new DateTime(2021, 9, 1), Skills = new List<string> {"採用", "労務管理", "研修企画"} },
            new Employee { Id = 7, Name = "伊藤大輔", Department = "開発", Salary = 450000, Age = 24, Position = "ジュニアエンジニア", HireDate = new DateTime(2023, 4, 1), Skills = new List<string> {"Java", "Spring", "MySQL"} },
            new Employee { Id = 8, Name = "渡辺咲良", Department = "デザイン", Salary = 550000, Age = 29, Position = "UIデザイナー", HireDate = new DateTime(2020, 2, 1), Skills = new List<string> {"Figma", "Adobe XD", "UX設計"} }
        };

        // 管理関係の設定
        employees[1].Manager = employees[0]; // 佐藤の上司は田中
        employees[2].Manager = employees[0]; // 鈴木の上司は田中
        employees[6].Manager = employees[0]; // 伊藤の上司は田中
        employees[0].DirectReports.AddRange(new[] { employees[1], employees[2], employees[6] });

        projects = new List<Project>
        {
            new Project { Id = 1, Name = "ECサイトリニューアル", StartDate = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1), Budget = 5000000, Status = "進行中", AssignedEmployeeIds = new List<int> {1, 2, 3, 8} },
            new Project { Id = 2, Name = "モバイルアプリ開発", StartDate = new DateTime(2024, 3, 1), Budget = 3000000, Status = "計画中", AssignedEmployeeIds = new List<int> {2, 7} },
            new Project { Id = 3, Name = "AI分析システム", StartDate = new DateTime(2023, 10, 1), EndDate = new DateTime(2024, 2, 28), Budget = 8000000, Status = "完了", AssignedEmployeeIds = new List<int> {3, 1} },
            new Project { Id = 4, Name = "品質管理システム", StartDate = new DateTime(2024, 2, 1), Budget = 2000000, Status = "進行中", AssignedEmployeeIds = new List<int> {4} }
        };
    }

    // 高度なクエリ例1: 複数条件での複雑フィルタリング
    public void ComplexFilteringExample()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("=== 複雑なフィルタリング例 ===");

        // マネージャーかつ開発部門で、かつ特定スキルを持つ従業員
        var complexFilter = employees
            .Where(e => e.Position.Contains("マネージャー") || e.Position.Contains("リード"))
            .Where(e => e.Department == "開発" || e.Department == "QA")
            .Where(e => e.Skills.Any(skill => skill.Contains("C#") || skill.Contains("テスト")))
            .Where(e => e.Salary >= 500000)
            .Where(e => DateTime.Now.Year - e.HireDate.Year >= 3);

        foreach (var emp in complexFilter)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"{emp.Name} - {emp.Position} ({emp.Department}) - スキル: {string.Join(", ", emp.Skills)}");
        }
    }

    // 高度なクエリ例2: ネストしたLINQとSelectMany
    public void NestedLinqExample()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("\n=== ネストしたLINQとSelectMany ===");

        // 全従業員のスキルを平坦化し、頻度順で表示
        var skillFrequency = employees
            .SelectMany(e => e.Skills, (employee, skill) => new { Employee = employee, Skill = skill })
            .GroupBy(x => x.Skill)
            .Select(g => new
            {
                Skill = g.Key,
                Count = g.Count(),
                Employees = g.Select(x => x.Employee.Name).ToList(),
                AverageSalary = g.Average(x => x.Employee.Salary)
            })
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.Count);

        foreach (var skill in skillFrequency)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"{skill.Skill}: {skill.Count}人保有, 平均給与: ¥{skill.AverageSalary:N0}");
            Console.WriteLine($"  保有者: {string.Join(", ", skill.Employees)}");
        }
    }

    // 高度なクエリ例3: 複雑なグループ化と集約
    public void ComplexGroupingExample()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("\n=== 複雑なグループ化と集約 ===");

        // 部署別、年代別の詳細統計
        var departmentAgeAnalysis = employees
            .GroupBy(e => e.Department)
            .Select(deptGroup => new
            {
                Department = deptGroup.Key,
                TotalEmployees = deptGroup.Count(),
                AverageSalary = deptGroup.Average(e => e.Salary),
                SalaryRange = new
                {
                    Min = deptGroup.Min(e => e.Salary),
                    Max = deptGroup.Max(e => e.Salary)
                },
                AgeGroups = deptGroup
                    .GroupBy(e => (e.Age / 10) * 10) // 年代でグループ化
                    .Select(ageGroup => new
                    {
                        AgeRange = $"{ageGroup.Key}代",
                        Count = ageGroup.Count(),
                        Names = ageGroup.Select(e => e.Name).ToList()
                    })
                    .OrderBy(ag => ag.AgeRange),
                MostCommonSkills = deptGroup
                    .SelectMany(e => e.Skills)
                    .GroupBy(skill => skill)
                    .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
                    .Take(3)
                    .Select(g => $"{g.Key}({g.Count()}人)")
                    .ToList()
            })
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.TotalEmployees);

        foreach (var dept in departmentAgeAnalysis)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"\n【{dept.Department}部】");
            Console.WriteLine($"  総人数: {dept.TotalEmployees}人");
            Console.WriteLine($"  平均給与: ¥{dept.AverageSalary:N0}");
            Console.WriteLine($"  給与範囲: ¥{dept.SalaryRange.Min:N0} - ¥{dept.SalaryRange.Max:N0}");
            Console.WriteLine($"  主要スキル: {string.Join(", ", dept.MostCommonSkills)}");

            Console.WriteLine("  年代別構成:");
            foreach (var ageGroup in dept.AgeGroups)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"    {ageGroup.AgeRange}: {ageGroup.Count}人 ({string.Join(", ", ageGroup.Names)})");
            }
        }
    }
}

docs.title: 1.2 条件付きクエリの動的構築
docs.text:
実際のアプリケーションでは、ユーザーの入力や設定に基づいて動的にクエリを構築する必要があります。

public class DynamicQueryBuilder
{
    public class SearchCriteria
    {
        public string NameFilter { get; set; }
        public string DepartmentFilter { get; set; }
        public decimal? MinSalary { get; set; }
        public decimal? MaxSalary { get; set; }
        public int? MinAge { get; set; }
        public int? MaxAge { get; set; }
        public List<string> RequiredSkills { get; set; } = new List<string>();
        public DateTime? HiredAfter { get; set; }
        public DateTime? HiredBefore { get; set; }
        public string SortBy { get; set; } = "Name";
        public bool SortDescending { get; set; } = false;
    }

    private List<Employee> employees;

    public IEnumerable<Employee> SearchEmployees(SearchCriteria criteria)
    {
        IQueryable<Employee> query = employees.AsQueryable();

        // 名前フィルター（部分一致）
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(criteria.NameFilter))
        {
            query = query.Where(e => e.Name.Contains(criteria.NameFilter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }

        // 部署フィルター
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(criteria.DepartmentFilter))
        {
            query = query.Where(e => e.Department == criteria.DepartmentFilter);
        }

        // 給与範囲フィルター
        if (criteria.MinSalary.HasValue)
        {
            query = query.Where(e => e.Salary >= criteria.MinSalary.Value);
        }

        if (criteria.MaxSalary.HasValue)
        {
            query = query.Where(e => e.Salary <= criteria.MaxSalary.Value);
        }

        // 年齢範囲フィルター
        if (criteria.MinAge.HasValue)
        {
            query = query.Where(e => e.Age >= criteria.MinAge.Value);
        }

        if (criteria.MaxAge.HasValue)
        {
            query = query.Where(e => e.Age <= criteria.MaxAge.Value);
        }

        // 必須スキルフィルター（すべてのスキルを持っている必要がある）
        if (criteria.RequiredSkills.Any())
        {
            foreach (var skill in criteria.RequiredSkills)
            {
                query = query.Where(e => e.Skills.Contains(skill, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            }
        }

        // 入社日フィルター
        if (criteria.HiredAfter.HasValue)
        {
            query = query.Where(e => e.HireDate >= criteria.HiredAfter.Value);
        }

        if (criteria.HiredBefore.HasValue)
        {
            query = query.Where(e => e.HireDate <= criteria.HiredBefore.Value);
        }

        // 動的ソート
        query = ApplySorting(query, criteria.SortBy, criteria.SortDescending);

        return query.ToList();
    }

    private IQueryable<Employee> ApplySorting(IQueryable<Employee> query, string sortBy, bool descending)
    {
        Expression<Func<Employee, object>> keySelector = sortBy?.ToLower() switch
        {
            "name" => e => e.Name,
            "department" => e => e.Department,
            "salary" => e => e.Salary,
            "age" => e => e.Age,
            "hiredate" => e => e.HireDate,
            "position" => e => e.Position,
            _ => e => e.Name
        };

        return descending 
            ? query.OrderByDescending(keySelector)
            : query.OrderBy(keySelector);
    }

    // 使用例
    public void DemonstrateDynamicQueries()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("=== 動的クエリの例 ===");

        // 例1: 開発部門で C# スキルを持つ高給取り
        var criteria1 = new SearchCriteria
        {
            DepartmentFilter = "開発",
            RequiredSkills = new List<string> { "C#" },
            MinSalary = 550000,
            SortBy = "Salary",
            SortDescending = true
        };

        var result1 = SearchEmployees(criteria1);
        Console.WriteLine("開発部門のC#エンジニア（高給取り順）:");
        foreach (var emp in result1)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"  {emp.Name} - ¥{emp.Salary:N0}");
        }

        // 例2: 若手エンジニア（年齢・入社日条件）
        var criteria2 = new SearchCriteria
        {
            MaxAge = 30,
            HiredAfter = new DateTime(2020, 1, 1),
            SortBy = "Age"
        };

        var result2 = SearchEmployees(criteria2);
        Console.WriteLine("\n若手社員（2020年以降入社、30歳以下）:");
        foreach (var emp in result2)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"  {emp.Name} - {emp.Age}歳 (入社: {emp.HireDate:yyyy/MM/dd})");
        }
    }
}

2.1 効率的なLINQ操作の選択
docs.text:
LINQは便利ですが、使い方によってはパフォーマンスに大きく影響します。適切な操作を選択することで劇的に性能を改善できます。

public class LinqPerformanceOptimization
{
    private List<int> largeDataSet;
    private List<Employee> employees;

    public LinqPerformanceOptimization()
    {
        // 大きなデータセットを生成（パフォーマンステスト用）
        largeDataSet = Enumerable.Range(1, 1_000_000).ToList();
        employees = GenerateEmployees(100_000);
    }

    private List<Employee> GenerateEmployees(int count)
    {
        var random = new Random();
        var departments = new[] { "開発", "営業", "人事", "総務", "QA" };
        var positions = new[] { "エンジニア", "マネージャー", "リード", "アシスタント" };

        return Enumerable.Range(1, count)
            .Select(i => new Employee
            {
                Id = i,
                Name = $"従業員{i}",
                Department = departments[random.Next(departments.Length)],
                Position = positions[random.Next(positions.Length)],
                Salary = random.Next(300000, 1000000),
                Age = random.Next(22, 65),
                HireDate = DateTime.Now.AddDays(-random.Next(0, 3650))
            })
            .ToList();
    }

    // 1. Any() vs Count() > 0 のパフォーマンス比較
    public void AnyVsCountComparison()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("=== Any() vs Count() > 0 パフォーマンス比較 ===");

        var stopwatch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();

        // 悪い例: Count() > 0
        stopwatch.Restart();
        bool hasHighSalaryCount = employees.Where(e => e.Salary > 800000).Count() > 0;
        stopwatch.Stop();
        long countTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;

        // 良い例: Any()
        stopwatch.Restart();
        bool hasHighSalaryAny = employees.Any(e => e.Salary > 800000);
        stopwatch.Stop();
        long anyTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;

        Console.WriteLine($"Count() > 0: {countTime}ms");
        Console.WriteLine($"Any(): {anyTime}ms");
        Console.WriteLine($"Any()は{(double)countTime / anyTime:F1}倍高速");
    }

    // 2. Where().Select() vs Select().Where() の最適化
    public void FilterSelectOptimization()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("\n=== フィルタリングと射影の順序最適化 ===");

        var stopwatch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();

        // 良い例: 先にフィルタリング
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var optimized = employees
            .Where(e => e.Department == "開発")        // 先に絞り込み
            .Where(e => e.Salary > 500000)
            .Select(e => new { e.Name, e.Salary })    // 後で射影
            .ToList();
        stopwatch.Stop();
        long optimizedTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;

        // 悪い例: 先に射影（非効率）
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var inefficient = employees
            .Select(e => new { Employee = e, IsTarget = e.Department == "開発" && e.Salary > 500000 })
            .Where(x => x.IsTarget)
            .Select(x => new { x.Employee.Name, x.Employee.Salary })
            .ToList();
        stopwatch.Stop();
        long inefficientTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;

        Console.WriteLine($"最適化版: {optimizedTime}ms");
        Console.WriteLine($"非効率版: {inefficientTime}ms");
        Console.WriteLine($"最適化により{(double)inefficientTime / optimizedTime:F1}倍高速化");
    }

    // 3. ToList()のタイミング最適化
    public void ToListTimingOptimization()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("\n=== ToList()のタイミング最適化 ===");

        var stopwatch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();

        // 悪い例: 早すぎるToList()
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var earlyToList = employees
            .ToList()                                // 早すぎる実体化
            .Where(e => e.Department == "開発")
            .Where(e => e.Salary > 500000)
            .Select(e => new { e.Name, e.Salary })
            .ToList();
        stopwatch.Stop();
        long earlyTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;

        // 良い例: 適切なタイミングでのToList()
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var appropriateToList = employees
            .Where(e => e.Department == "開発")      // 先にフィルタリング
            .Where(e => e.Salary > 500000)
            .Select(e => new { e.Name, e.Salary })
            .ToList();                               // 最後に実体化
        stopwatch.Stop();
        long appropriateTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;

        Console.WriteLine($"早すぎるToList(): {earlyTime}ms");
        Console.WriteLine($"適切なタイミング: {appropriateTime}ms");
        Console.WriteLine($"適切なタイミングで{(double)earlyTime / appropriateTime:F1}倍高速化");
    }

    // 4. 複数回列挙の回避
    public void AvoidMultipleEnumeration()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("\n=== 複数回列挙の回避 ===");

        var expensiveQuery = employees
            .Where(e => e.Department == "開発")
            .Select(e => new { e.Name, e.Salary, ProcessingTime = DateTime.Now }); // 重い処理をシミュレート

        var stopwatch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();

        // 悪い例: 複数回列挙
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var count1 = expensiveQuery.Count();
        var average1 = expensiveQuery.Average(x => x.Salary);
        var max1 = expensiveQuery.Max(x => x.Salary);
        stopwatch.Stop();
        long multipleEnumTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;

        // 良い例: 一度だけ列挙
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var materialized = expensiveQuery.ToList();
        var count2 = materialized.Count;
        var average2 = materialized.Average(x => x.Salary);
        var max2 = materialized.Max(x => x.Salary);
        stopwatch.Stop();
        long singleEnumTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;

        Console.WriteLine($"複数回列挙: {multipleEnumTime}ms");
        Console.WriteLine($"一度だけ列挙: {singleEnumTime}ms");
        Console.WriteLine($"一度だけ列挙で{(double)multipleEnumTime / singleEnumTime:F1}倍高速化");
    }
}

docs.title: 2.2 インデックスとハッシュテーブルの活用
docs.text:
大量データの検索処理では、適切なデータ構造の選択が重要です。

public class IndexOptimization
{
    private List<Employee> employees;
    private Dictionary<string, List<Employee>> departmentIndex;
    private Dictionary<int, Employee> employeeIndex;
    private HashSet<string> skillSet;

    public IndexOptimization(List<Employee> employees)
    {
        this.employees = employees;
        BuildIndexes();
    }

    private void BuildIndexes()
    {
        // 部署別インデックス
        departmentIndex = employees
            .GroupBy(e => e.Department)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.ToList());

        // ID別インデックス
        employeeIndex = employees.ToDictionary(e => e.Id);

        // スキルセット
        skillSet = employees
            .SelectMany(e => e.Skills)
            .ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    // インデックスを使わない検索（遅い）
    public List<Employee> SearchByDepartmentSlow(string department)
    {
        return employees.Where(e => e.Department == department).ToList();
    }

    // インデックスを使った検索（速い）
    public List<Employee> SearchByDepartmentFast(string department)
    {
        return departmentIndex.TryGetValue(department, out var result) 
            ? result 
            : new List<Employee>();
    }

    // ID検索の比較
    public Employee FindByIdSlow(int id)
    {
        return employees.FirstOrDefault(e => e.Id == id);
    }

    public Employee FindByIdFast(int id)
    {
        return employeeIndex.TryGetValue(id, out var employee) ? employee : null;
    }

    // スキル存在チェックの比較
    public bool HasSkillSlow(string skill)
    {
        return employees.Any(e => e.Skills.Contains(skill, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
    }

    public bool HasSkillFast(string skill)
    {
        return skillSet.Contains(skill);
    }

    public void BenchmarkSearchOperations()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("=== 検索操作のベンチマーク ===");

        var stopwatch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();

        // 部署検索のベンチマーク
        stopwatch.Restart();
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
        {
            var result = SearchByDepartmentSlow("開発");
        }
        stopwatch.Stop();
        long slowDeptTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;

        stopwatch.Restart();
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
        {
            var result = SearchByDepartmentFast("開発");
        }
        stopwatch.Stop();
        long fastDeptTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;

        Console.WriteLine($"部署検索 - 通常: {slowDeptTime}ms, インデックス: {fastDeptTime}ms");
        Console.WriteLine($"インデックスにより{(double)slowDeptTime / fastDeptTime:F1}倍高速化");

        // ID検索のベンチマーク
        stopwatch.Restart();
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
        {
            var result = FindByIdSlow(50000);
        }
        stopwatch.Stop();
        long slowIdTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;

        stopwatch.Restart();
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
        {
            var result = FindByIdFast(50000);
        }
        stopwatch.Stop();
        long fastIdTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;

        Console.WriteLine($"ID検索 - 通常: {slowIdTime}ms, インデックス: {fastIdTime}ms");
        Console.WriteLine($"インデックスにより{(double)slowIdTime / fastIdTime:F1}倍高速化");
    }
}

docs.title: 3. カスタム拡張メソッドの設計と実装
3.1 基本的な拡張メソッド
docs.text:
再利用可能な拡張メソッドを作成することで、コードの可読性と保守性が向上します。

public static class BasicLinqExtensions
{
    // 条件付きWhere
    public static IEnumerable<T> WhereIf<T>(this IEnumerable<T> source, bool condition, Func<T, bool> predicate)
    {
        return condition ? source.Where(predicate) : source;
    }

    // 安全なFirstOrDefault（null許容参照型対応）
    public static T SafeFirstOrDefault<T>(this IEnumerable<T> source, Func<T, bool> predicate = null)
        where T : class
    {
        try
        {
            return predicate != null ? source.FirstOrDefault(predicate) : source.FirstOrDefault();
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    // ページネーション
    public static IEnumerable<T> Page<T>(this IEnumerable<T> source, int pageNumber, int pageSize)
    {
        if (pageNumber < 1) pageNumber = 1;
        if (pageSize < 1) pageSize = 10;

        return source
            .Skip((pageNumber - 1) * pageSize)
            .Take(pageSize);
    }

    // Null要素の除去
    public static IEnumerable<T> WhereNotNull<T>(this IEnumerable<T?> source)
        where T : class
    {
        return source.Where(item => item != null).Cast<T>();
    }

    // 重複除去（カスタムキー指定）
    public static IEnumerable<T> DistinctBy<T, TKey>(this IEnumerable<T> source, Func<T, TKey> keySelector)
    {
        var seen = new HashSet<TKey>();
        foreach (var item in source)
        {
            var key = keySelector(item);
            if (seen.Add(key))
            {
                yield return item;
            }
        }
    }

    // 使用例
    public static void DemonstrateBasicExtensions()
    {
        var employees = GetSampleEmployees();

        Console.WriteLine("=== 基本拡張メソッドの使用例 ===");

        // WhereIf の使用例
        bool includeManagers = true;
        bool filterBySalary = false;
        decimal minSalary = 500000;

        var filtered = employees
            .WhereIf(includeManagers, e => e.Position.Contains("マネージャー"))
            .WhereIf(filterBySalary, e => e.Salary >= minSalary);

        Console.WriteLine("条件付きフィルタリング結果:");
        foreach (var emp in filtered)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"  {emp.Name} - {emp.Position}");
        }

        // ページネーション の使用例
        var page2 = employees.Page(2, 3);
        Console.WriteLine("\n2ページ目（3件ずつ）:");
        foreach (var emp in page2)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"  {emp.Name}");
        }

        // DistinctBy の使用例
        var uniqueDepartments = employees.DistinctBy(e => e.Department);
        Console.WriteLine("\n部署ごとの代表者:");
        foreach (var emp in uniqueDepartments)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"  {emp.Department}: {emp.Name}");
        }
    }
}

docs.title: 3.2 高度な拡張メソッド
docs.text:
より複雑で実用的な拡張メソッドを作成します。

public static class AdvancedLinqExtensions
{
    // バッチ処理（指定サイズでグループ化）
    public static IEnumerable<IEnumerable<T>> Batch<T>(this IEnumerable<T> source, int batchSize)
    {
        if (batchSize <= 0) throw new ArgumentException("Batch size must be positive", nameof(batchSize));

        var batch = new List<T>(batchSize);
        foreach (var item in source)
        {
            batch.Add(item);
            if (batch.Count == batchSize)
            {
                yield return batch;
                batch = new List<T>(batchSize);
            }
        }

        if (batch.Count > 0)
        {
            yield return batch;
        }
    }

    // 移動平均の計算
    public static IEnumerable<decimal> MovingAverage(this IEnumerable<decimal> source, int windowSize)
    {
        if (windowSize <= 0) throw new ArgumentException("Window size must be positive", nameof(windowSize));

        var window = new Queue<decimal>();
        decimal sum = 0;

        foreach (var value in source)
        {
            window.Enqueue(value);
            sum += value;

            if (window.Count > windowSize)
            {
                sum -= window.Dequeue();
            }

            if (window.Count == windowSize)
            {
                yield return sum / windowSize;
            }
        }
    }

    // 条件に基づく分割
    public static (IEnumerable<T> matching, IEnumerable<T> nonMatching) PartitionBy<T>(
        this IEnumerable<T> source, Func<T, bool> predicate)
    {
        var sourceList = source.ToList(); // 複数回列挙を避ける
        return (sourceList.Where(predicate), sourceList.Where(x => !predicate(x)));
    }

    // 統計情報の一括取得
    public static StatisticsResult<T> GetStatistics<T>(this IEnumerable<T> source, Func<T, decimal> selector)
    {
        var values = source.Select(selector).ToList();

        if (!values.Any())
        {
            return new StatisticsResult<T>
            {
                Count = 0,
                Sum = 0,
                Average = 0,
                Min = 0,
                Max = 0,
                Median = 0,
                StandardDeviation = 0
            };
        }

        var sorted = values.OrderBy(x => x).ToList();
        var count = values.Count;
        var sum = values.Sum();
        var average = values.Average();
        var min = values.Min();
        var max = values.Max();

        var median = count % 2 == 0
            ? (sorted[count / 2 - 1] + sorted[count / 2]) / 2
            : sorted[count / 2];

        var variance = values.Sum(v => Math.Pow((double)(v - average), 2)) / count;
        var standardDeviation = (decimal)Math.Sqrt(variance);

        return new StatisticsResult<T>
        {
            Count = count,
            Sum = sum,
            Average = average,
            Min = min,
            Max = max,
            Median = median,
            StandardDeviation = standardDeviation
        };
    }

    // 階層構造のフラット化
    public static IEnumerable<T> Flatten<T>(this IEnumerable<T> source, Func<T, IEnumerable<T>> childSelector)
    {
        var stack = new Stack<T>(source.Reverse());

        while (stack.Count > 0)
        {
            var current = stack.Pop();
            yield return current;

            var children = childSelector(current);
            if (children != null)
            {
                foreach (var child in children.Reverse())
                {
                    stack.Push(child);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // 文字列結合の高度版
    public static string JoinWith<T>(this IEnumerable<T> source, 
        string separator, 
        Func<T, string> selector = null,
        string prefix = "",
        string suffix = "")
    {
        selector ??= item => item?.ToString() ?? "";
        var result = string.Join(separator, source.Select(selector));
        return $"{prefix}{result}{suffix}";
    }

    // 使用例
    public static void DemonstrateAdvancedExtensions()
    {
        var employees = GetSampleEmployees();
        var salaries = new decimal[] { 400000, 500000, 600000, 550000, 700000, 650000, 800000 };

        Console.WriteLine("=== 高度な拡張メソッドの使用例 ===");

        // バッチ処理
        Console.WriteLine("バッチ処理（3人ずつ）:");
        var batches = employees.Batch(3);
        int batchNumber = 1;
        foreach (var batch in batches)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"  バッチ{batchNumber}: {batch.JoinWith(", ", e => e.Name)}");
            batchNumber++;
        }

        // 移動平均
        Console.WriteLine("\n移動平均（3期間）:");
        var movingAverages = salaries.MovingAverage(3);
        foreach (var avg in movingAverages)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"  ¥{avg:N0}");
        }

        // パーティション
        var (seniors, juniors) = employees.PartitionBy(e => e.Age >= 30);
        Console.WriteLine($"\nシニア: {seniors.Count()}人, ジュニア: {juniors.Count()}人");

        // 統計情報
        var salaryStats = employees.GetStatistics(e => e.Salary);
        Console.WriteLine("\n給与統計:");
        Console.WriteLine($"  平均: ¥{salaryStats.Average:N0}");
        Console.WriteLine($"  中央値: ¥{salaryStats.Median:N0}");
        Console.WriteLine($"  標準偏差: ¥{salaryStats.StandardDeviation:N0}");

        // 階層構造のフラット化（管理関係）
        var allInHierarchy = employees
            .Where(e => e.Manager == null) // トップレベルのみ
            .Flatten(e => e.DirectReports);

        Console.WriteLine("\n組織階層（フラット化）:");
        foreach (var emp in allInHierarchy)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"  {emp.Name} ({emp.Position})");
        }
    }
}

public class StatisticsResult<T>
{
    public int Count { get; set; }
    public decimal Sum { get; set; }
    public decimal Average { get; set; }
    public decimal Min { get; set; }
    public decimal Max { get; set; }
    public decimal Median { get; set; }
    public decimal StandardDeviation { get; set; }
}

docs.title: 3.3 ビジネス固有の拡張メソッド
docs.text:
実際のビジネス要件に特化した拡張メソッドを作成します。

public static class BusinessLinqExtensions
{
    // 従業員関連の拡張メソッド
    public static IEnumerable<Employee> WithExperience(this IEnumerable<Employee> employees, int minYears)
    {
        var cutoffDate = DateTime.Now.AddYears(-minYears);
        return employees.Where(e => e.HireDate <= cutoffDate);
    }

    public static IEnumerable<Employee> InDepartments(this IEnumerable<Employee> employees, params string[] departments)
    {
        var deptSet = departments.ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        return employees.Where(e => deptSet.Contains(e.Department));
    }

    public static IEnumerable<Employee> WithSkills(this IEnumerable<Employee> employees, params string[] skills)
    {
        return employees.Where(e => skills.All(skill => 
            e.Skills.Contains(skill, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)));
    }

    public static IEnumerable<Employee> WithAnySkills(this IEnumerable<Employee> employees, params string[] skills)
    {
        return employees.Where(e => skills.Any(skill => 
            e.Skills.Contains(skill, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)));
    }

    public static IEnumerable<Employee> InSalaryRange(this IEnumerable<Employee> employees, decimal min, decimal max)
    {
        return employees.Where(e => e.Salary >= min && e.Salary <= max);
    }

    public static IEnumerable<Employee> InAgeRange(this IEnumerable<Employee> employees, int minAge, int maxAge)
    {
        return employees.Where(e => e.Age >= minAge && e.Age <= maxAge);
    }

    // 集約拡張メソッド
    public static decimal AverageSalary(this IEnumerable<Employee> employees)
    {
        return employees.Any() ? employees.Average(e => e.Salary) : 0;
    }

    public static IEnumerable<IGrouping<string, Employee>> GroupByDepartment(this IEnumerable<Employee> employees)
    {
        return employees.GroupBy(e => e.Department);
    }

    public static IEnumerable<IGrouping<string, Employee>> GroupByPosition(this IEnumerable<Employee> employees)
    {
        return employees.GroupBy(e => e.Position);
    }

    // プロジェクト関連の拡張メソッド
    public static IEnumerable<Project> Active(this IEnumerable<Project> projects)
    {
        return projects.Where(p => p.Status == "進行中");
    }

    public static IEnumerable<Project> Completed(this IEnumerable<Project> projects)
    {
        return projects.Where(p => p.Status == "完了");
    }

    public static IEnumerable<Project> WithBudgetRange(this IEnumerable<Project> projects, decimal min, decimal max)
    {
        return projects.Where(p => p.Budget >= min && p.Budget <= max);
    }

    public static IEnumerable<Project> StartedInPeriod(this IEnumerable<Project> projects, DateTime start, DateTime end)
    {
        return projects.Where(p => p.StartDate >= start && p.StartDate <= end);
    }

    // 複合クエリのサンプル
    public static void DemonstrateBusinessExtensions()
    {
        var employees = GetSampleEmployees();
        var projects = GetSampleProjects();

        Console.WriteLine("=== ビジネス固有拡張メソッドの使用例 ===");

        // 流暢なAPI（Fluent API）の例
        var seniorDevelopers = employees
            .InDepartments("開発", "QA")
            .WithExperience(3)
            .WithAnySkills("C#", "Python", "テスト自動化")
            .InSalaryRange(500000, 1000000)
            .OrderByDescending(e => e.Salary);

        Console.WriteLine("シニア開発者（3年以上経験、主要スキル保有、高給与）:");
        foreach (var dev in seniorDevelopers)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"  {dev.Name} - {dev.Position} (¥{dev.Salary:N0}) - スキル: {string.Join(", ", dev.Skills)}");
        }

        // 部署別統計
        Console.WriteLine("\n部署別統計:");
        var deptStats = employees
            .GroupByDepartment()
            .Select(g => new
            {
                Department = g.Key,
                Count = g.Count(),
                AverageSalary = g.AverageSalary(),
                AverageAge = g.Average(e => e.Age),
                TotalExperience = g.Sum(e => DateTime.Now.Year - e.HireDate.Year)
            })
            .OrderByDescending(s => s.AverageSalary);

        foreach (var stat in deptStats)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"  {stat.Department}: {stat.Count}人, 平均給与¥{stat.AverageSalary:N0}, 平均年齢{stat.AverageAge:F1}歳");
        }

        // アクティブプロジェクトの分析
        Console.WriteLine("\nアクティブプロジェクト分析:");
        var activeProjectStats = projects
            .Active()
            .WithBudgetRange(1000000, 10000000)
            .Select(p => new
            {
                p.Name,
                p.Budget,
                Duration = (DateTime.Now - p.StartDate).Days,
                TeamSize = p.AssignedEmployeeIds.Count
            })
            .OrderByDescending(p => p.Budget);

        foreach (var project in activeProjectStats)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"  {project.Name}: 予算¥{project.Budget:N0}, 期間{project.Duration}日, チーム{project.TeamSize}人");
        }
    }
}

4.1 レポート生成システム
docs.text:
複雑なビジネスレポートの生成にLINQを活用します。

public class ReportGenerator
{
    private List<Employee> employees;
    private List<Project> projects;

    public ReportGenerator(List<Employee> employees, List<Project> projects)
    {
        this.employees = employees;
        this.projects = projects;
    }

    // 総合人事レポート
    public ComprehensiveHRReport GenerateHRReport()
    {
        var currentDate = DateTime.Now;

        // 部署別分析
        var departmentAnalysis = employees
            .GroupBy(e => e.Department)
            .Select(g => new DepartmentAnalysis
            {
                Department = g.Key,
                HeadCount = g.Count(),
                AverageSalary = g.Average(e => e.Salary),
                SalaryRange = new SalaryRange
                {
                    Min = g.Min(e => e.Salary),
                    Max = g.Max(e => e.Salary)
                },
                AverageAge = g.Average(e => e.Age),
                AverageExperience = g.Average(e => (currentDate - e.HireDate).Days / 365.25),
                SkillDistribution = g
                    .SelectMany(e => e.Skills)
                    .GroupBy(skill => skill)
                    .ToDictionary(sg => sg.Key, sg => sg.Count()),
                TurnoverRate = CalculateTurnoverRate(g.ToList())
            })
            .OrderByDescending(d => d.HeadCount)
            .ToList();

        // 給与分析
        var salaryAnalysis = new SalaryAnalysis
        {
            Overall = employees.GetStatistics(e => e.Salary),
            ByDepartment = employees
                .GroupBy(e => e.Department)
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.GetStatistics(e => e.Salary)),
            ByPosition = employees
                .GroupBy(e => e.Position)
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.GetStatistics(e => e.Salary)),
            PayGapAnalysis = AnalyzePayGaps()
        };

        // スキル分析
        var skillAnalysis = new SkillAnalysis
        {
            MostInDemandSkills = employees
                .SelectMany(e => e.Skills)
                .GroupBy(skill => skill)
                .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
                .Take(10)
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Count()),
            SkillsByDepartment = employees
                .GroupBy(e => e.Department)
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g
                    .SelectMany(e => e.Skills)
                    .GroupBy(skill => skill)
                    .OrderByDescending(sg => sg.Count())
                    .Take(5)
                    .ToDictionary(sg => sg.Key, sg => sg.Count())),
            RareSkills = FindRareSkills()
        };

        // 組織構造分析
        var organizationAnalysis = new OrganizationAnalysis
        {
            ManagementLayers = CalculateManagementLayers(),
            SpanOfControl = CalculateSpanOfControl(),
            TeamDistribution = AnalyzeTeamDistribution()
        };

        return new ComprehensiveHRReport
        {
            GeneratedDate = currentDate,
            TotalEmployees = employees.Count,
            DepartmentAnalysis = departmentAnalysis,
            SalaryAnalysis = salaryAnalysis,
            SkillAnalysis = skillAnalysis,
            OrganizationAnalysis = organizationAnalysis,
            Recommendations = GenerateRecommendations(departmentAnalysis, salaryAnalysis, skillAnalysis)
        };
    }

    // プロジェクト分析レポート
    public ProjectAnalysisReport GenerateProjectReport()
    {
        var currentDate = DateTime.Now;

        // プロジェクト状況分析
        var statusAnalysis = projects
            .GroupBy(p => p.Status)
            .Select(g => new ProjectStatusAnalysis
            {
                Status = g.Key,
                Count = g.Count(),
                TotalBudget = g.Sum(p => p.Budget),
                AverageBudget = g.Average(p => p.Budget),
                AverageDuration = g.Average(p => p.EndDate.HasValue 
                    ? (p.EndDate.Value - p.StartDate).Days 
                    : (currentDate - p.StartDate).Days)
            })
            .ToList();

        // 予算分析
        var budgetAnalysis = new ProjectBudgetAnalysis
        {
            TotalBudget = projects.Sum(p => p.Budget),
            CompletedProjectsBudget = projects.Where(p => p.Status == "完了").Sum(p => p.Budget),
            ActiveProjectsBudget = projects.Where(p => p.Status == "進行中").Sum(p => p.Budget),
            BudgetByQuarter = projects
                .GroupBy(p => new { Year = p.StartDate.Year, Quarter = (p.StartDate.Month - 1) / 3 + 1 })
                .ToDictionary(g => $"{g.Key.Year}Q{g.Key.Quarter}", g => g.Sum(p => p.Budget))
        };

        // チーム効率性分析
        var teamEfficiencyAnalysis = AnalyzeTeamEfficiency();

        return new ProjectAnalysisReport
        {
            GeneratedDate = currentDate,
            TotalProjects = projects.Count,
            StatusAnalysis = statusAnalysis,
            BudgetAnalysis = budgetAnalysis,
            TeamEfficiencyAnalysis = teamEfficiencyAnalysis,
            ProjectRecommendations = GenerateProjectRecommendations()
        };
    }

    // 補助メソッド
    private double CalculateTurnoverRate(List<Employee> departmentEmployees)
    {
        // 実際の実装では退職者データも考慮
        return 5.0; // ダミー値
    }

    private Dictionary<string, decimal> AnalyzePayGaps()
    {
        return new Dictionary<string, decimal>
        {
            ["性別間格差"] = 0.85m, // ダミー値
            ["年代間格差"] = 1.2m,
            ["経験年数格差"] = 1.1m
        };
    }

    private List<string> FindRareSkills()
    {
        return employees
            .SelectMany(e => e.Skills)
            .GroupBy(skill => skill)
            .Where(g => g.Count() <= 2)
            .Select(g => g.Key)
            .ToList();
    }

    private int CalculateManagementLayers()
    {
        // 組織階層の深さを計算
        return 3; // ダミー値
    }

    private Dictionary<string, int> CalculateSpanOfControl()
    {
        return employees
            .Where(e => e.DirectReports.Any())
            .ToDictionary(e => e.Name, e => e.DirectReports.Count);
    }

    private Dictionary<string, int> AnalyzeTeamDistribution()
    {
        return employees
            .GroupBy(e => e.Department)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Count());
    }

    private List<string> GenerateRecommendations(
        List<DepartmentAnalysis> deptAnalysis,
        SalaryAnalysis salaryAnalysis,
        SkillAnalysis skillAnalysis)
    {
        var recommendations = new List<string>();

        // 給与格差が大きい部署を特定
        var salaryGapDepts = deptAnalysis
            .Where(d => d.SalaryRange.Max - d.SalaryRange.Min > 400000)
            .Select(d => d.Department);

        foreach (var dept in salaryGapDepts)
        {
            recommendations.Add($"{dept}部の給与格差（¥{deptAnalysis.First(d => d.Department == dept).SalaryRange.Max - deptAnalysis.First(d => d.Department == dept).SalaryRange.Min:N0}）の見直しを推奨");
        }

        // 希少スキルの獲得推奨
        if (skillAnalysis.RareSkills.Any())
        {
            recommendations.Add($"希少スキル（{string.Join(", ", skillAnalysis.RareSkills)}）の育成・採用を推奨");
        }

        return recommendations;
    }

    private TeamEfficiencyAnalysis AnalyzeTeamEfficiency()
    {
        // プロジェクトとチームメンバーの効率性分析
        return new TeamEfficiencyAnalysis
        {
            AverageProjectDuration = projects
                .Where(p => p.EndDate.HasValue)
                .Average(p => (p.EndDate.Value - p.StartDate).Days),
            ProductivityMetrics = CalculateProductivityMetrics(),
            ResourceUtilization = CalculateResourceUtilization()
        };
    }

    private Dictionary<string, double> CalculateProductivityMetrics()
    {
        return new Dictionary<string, double>
        {
            ["予算効率"] = 1.2, // ダミー値
            ["時間効率"] = 0.95,
            ["品質指標"] = 4.2
        };
    }

    private Dictionary<string, double> CalculateResourceUtilization()
    {
        return employees
            .InDepartments("開発", "QA")
            .GroupBy(e => e.Department)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => 85.0); // ダミー値
    }

    private List<string> GenerateProjectRecommendations()
    {
        return new List<string>
        {
            "開発部門のリソース配分最適化を推奨",
            "QA工程の自動化により効率性向上が期待される",
            "予算管理プロセスの改善を推奨"
        };
    }
}

docs.title: 4.2 データマイニングとトレンド分析
docs.text:
LINQを使用して大量のデータから有意義なパターンやトレンドを抽出します。

public class DataMiningEngine
{
    private List<Employee> employees;
    private List<Project> projects;
    private List<SalesData> salesData;

    public class SalesData
    {
        public DateTime Date { get; set; }
        public string Product { get; set; }
        public decimal Amount { get; set; }
        public string Region { get; set; }
        public string SalesPerson { get; set; }
    }

    // トレンド分析
    public TrendAnalysisResult AnalyzeTrends()
    {
        // 採用トレンド分析
        var hiringTrends = employees
            .GroupBy(e => new { Year = e.HireDate.Year, Month = e.HireDate.Month })
            .Select(g => new
            {
                Period = new DateTime(g.Key.Year, g.Key.Month, 1),
                HiringCount = g.Count(),
                AverageSalary = g.Average(e => e.Salary),
                DepartmentMix = g.GroupBy(e => e.Department)
                                .ToDictionary(dg => dg.Key, dg => dg.Count())
            })
            .OrderBy(x => x.Period)
            .ToList();

        // 給与上昇トレンド
        var salaryTrends = employees
            .GroupBy(e => e.HireDate.Year)
            .Select(g => new
            {
                Year = g.Key,
                AverageSalary = g.Average(e => e.Salary),
                MedianSalary = g.OrderBy(e => e.Salary).ElementAt(g.Count() / 2).Salary,
                TopTierSalary = g.OrderByDescending(e => e.Salary).Take(g.Count() / 10).Average(e => e.Salary)
            })
            .OrderBy(x => x.Year)
            .ToList();

        // スキル需要トレンド
        var skillTrends = employees
            .SelectMany(e => e.Skills.Select(skill => new { e.HireDate.Year, Skill = skill }))
            .GroupBy(x => x.Year)
            .Select(g => new
            {
                Year = g.Key,
                SkillDistribution = g.GroupBy(x => x.Skill)
                                   .ToDictionary(sg => sg.Key, sg => sg.Count()),
                EmergingSkills = g.GroupBy(x => x.Skill)
                                .Where(sg => sg.Count() > 1)
                                .Select(sg => sg.Key)
                                .ToList()
            })
            .OrderBy(x => x.Year)
            .ToList();

        return new TrendAnalysisResult
        {
            HiringTrends = hiringTrends.Select(ht => new
            {
                Period = ht.Period.ToString("yyyy-MM"),
                Count = ht.HiringCount,
                AvgSalary = ht.AverageSalary
            }).ToList(),
            SalaryTrends = salaryTrends,
            SkillTrends = skillTrends
        };
    }

    // パターン発見
    public PatternAnalysisResult DiscoverPatterns()
    {
        // 高パフォーマー特性分析
        var highPerformers = employees
            .Where(e => e.Salary > employees.Average(emp => emp.Salary) * 1.2m)
            .ToList();

        var highPerformerPatterns = new
        {
            CommonSkills = highPerformers
                .SelectMany(e => e.Skills)
                .GroupBy(skill => skill)
                .Where(g => g.Count() >= highPerformers.Count * 0.6) // 60%以上が保有
                .Select(g => g.Key)
                .ToList(),
            CommonDepartments = highPerformers
                .GroupBy(e => e.Department)
                .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
                .Select(g => new { Department = g.Key, Count = g.Count() })
                .ToList(),
            AverageExperience = highPerformers
                .Average(e => (DateTime.Now - e.HireDate).Days / 365.25),
            AverageAge = highPerformers.Average(e => e.Age)
        };

        // 部署間移動パターン（仮想データ）
        var departmentTransitions = AnalyzeDepartmentTransitions();

        // プロジェクト成功パターン
        var successPatterns = projects
            .Where(p => p.Status == "完了")
            .Select(p => new
            {
                Project = p,
                TeamSkills = p.AssignedEmployeeIds
                    .Join(employees, id => id, e => e.Id, (id, e) => e)
                    .SelectMany(e => e.Skills)
                    .GroupBy(skill => skill)
                    .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Count()),
                TeamSize = p.AssignedEmployeeIds.Count,
                Duration = p.EndDate.HasValue ? (p.EndDate.Value - p.StartDate).Days : 0,
                BudgetEfficiency = p.Budget > 0 ? 1.0 : 0.0 // 簡略化
            })
            .ToList();

        return new PatternAnalysisResult
        {
            HighPerformerPatterns = highPerformerPatterns,
            DepartmentTransitions = departmentTransitions,
            ProjectSuccessPatterns = successPatterns
        };
    }

    // 予測分析
    public PredictionResult GeneratePredictions()
    {
        // 退職リスク予測（簡略化されたロジック）
        var atRiskEmployees = employees
            .Select(e => new
            {
                Employee = e,
                RiskScore = CalculateAttritionRisk(e),
                RiskFactors = GetRiskFactors(e)
            })
            .Where(x => x.RiskScore > 0.7)
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.RiskScore)
            .ToList();

        // 採用需要予測
        var hiringPrediction = employees
            .GroupBy(e => e.Department)
            .Select(g => new
            {
                Department = g.Key,
                CurrentSize = g.Count(),
                ProjectedGrowth = CalculateProjectedGrowth(g.Key),
                SkillGaps = IdentifySkillGaps(g.Key),
                RecommendedHires = CalculateRecommendedHires(g.Key)
            })
            .ToList();

        // プロジェクト成功確率予測
        var projectPredictions = projects
            .Where(p => p.Status == "進行中" || p.Status == "計画中")
            .Select(p => new
            {
                Project = p,
                SuccessProbability = PredictProjectSuccess(p),
                RiskFactors = IdentifyProjectRisks(p),
                Recommendations = GenerateProjectRecommendations(p)
            })
            .ToList();

        return new PredictionResult
        {
            AtRiskEmployees = atRiskEmployees,
            HiringPredictions = hiringPrediction,
            ProjectPredictions = projectPredictions
        };
    }

    // 補助メソッド（予測ロジックは簡略化）
    private double CalculateAttritionRisk(Employee employee)
    {
        var experience = (DateTime.Now - employee.HireDate).Days / 365.25;
        var salaryPercentile = employees.Count(e => e.Salary <= employee.Salary) / (double)employees.Count;

        // 簡略化されたリスクスコア計算
        var riskScore = 0.0;

        if (experience < 1) riskScore += 0.3; // 新人は退職リスクが高い
        if (experience > 5) riskScore += 0.2; // ベテランも転職を考えやすい
        if (salaryPercentile < 0.3) riskScore += 0.4; // 低給与はリスク
        if (employee.Age < 30) riskScore += 0.2; // 若手は転職しやすい

        return Math.Min(riskScore, 1.0);
    }

    private List<string> GetRiskFactors(Employee employee)
    {
        var factors = new List<string>();

        var experience = (DateTime.Now - employee.HireDate).Days / 365.25;
        var salaryPercentile = employees.Count(e => e.Salary <= employee.Salary) / (double)employees.Count;

        if (experience < 1) factors.Add("新入社員（定着率が低い傾向）");
        if (salaryPercentile < 0.3) factors.Add("同僚比較で低給与");
        if (employee.Age < 30) factors.Add("転職活発年代");

        return factors;
    }

    private double CalculateProjectedGrowth(string department)
    {
        // 部署別成長率の予測（簡略化）
        return department switch
        {
            "開発" => 1.15,
            "QA" => 1.10,
            "営業" => 1.05,
            _ => 1.0
        };
    }

    private List<string> IdentifySkillGaps(string department)
    {
        // 部署別スキルギャップの特定（簡略化）
        return department switch
        {
            "開発" => new List<string> { "クラウド技術", "AI/ML", "マイクロサービス" },
            "QA" => new List<string> { "テスト自動化", "性能テスト" },
            _ => new List<string>()
        };
    }

    private int CalculateRecommendedHires(string department)
    {
        var currentSize = employees.Count(e => e.Department == department);
        var growthRate = CalculateProjectedGrowth(department);
        return (int)Math.Ceiling(currentSize * (growthRate - 1));
    }

    private double PredictProjectSuccess(Project project)
    {
        // プロジェクト成功確率の予測（簡略化）
        var teamSize = project.AssignedEmployeeIds.Count;
        var budgetCategory = project.Budget switch
        {
            < 1000000 => "小規模",
            < 5000000 => "中規模",
            _ => "大規模"
        };

        return budgetCategory switch
        {
            "小規模" => 0.85,
            "中規模" => 0.70,
            "大規模" => 0.60,
            _ => 0.50
        };
    }

    private List<string> IdentifyProjectRisks(Project project)
    {
        var risks = new List<string>();

        if (project.Budget > 5000000) risks.Add("大規模予算によるリスク");
        if (project.AssignedEmployeeIds.Count > 10) risks.Add("大規模チームによる調整リスク");
        if ((DateTime.Now - project.StartDate).Days > 365) risks.Add("長期プロジェクトによる計画変更リスク");

        return risks;
    }

    private List<string> GenerateProjectRecommendations(Project project)
    {
        var recommendations = new List<string>();

        if (project.AssignedEmployeeIds.Count < 3) 
            recommendations.Add("チーム規模の拡大を検討");

        if (project.Budget > 5000000) 
            recommendations.Add("マイルストーン管理の強化を推奨");

        return recommendations;
    }

    private List<object> AnalyzeDepartmentTransitions()
    {
        // 部署間移動パターンの分析（簡略化）
        return new List<object>
        {
            new { From = "開発", To = "QA", Frequency = 0.15 },
            new { From = "QA", To = "開発", Frequency = 0.10 },
            new { From = "営業", To = "人事", Frequency = 0.05 }
        };
    }
}

// 結果クラス
public class TrendAnalysisResult
{
    public List<object> HiringTrends { get; set; }
    public List<object> SalaryTrends { get; set; }
    public List<object> SkillTrends { get; set; }
}

public class PatternAnalysisResult
{
    public object HighPerformerPatterns { get; set; }
    public List<object> DepartmentTransitions { get; set; }
    public List<object> ProjectSuccessPatterns { get; set; }
}

public class PredictionResult
{
    public List<object> AtRiskEmployees { get; set; }
    public List<object> HiringPredictions { get; set; }
    public List<object> ProjectPredictions { get; set; }
}

docs.text:
public class ComprehensiveDataAnalysisSystem
{
    private List<Customer> customers;
    private List<Product> products;
    private List<Sale> sales;

    public ComprehensiveDataAnalysisSystem()
    {
        InitializeData();
    }

    private void InitializeData()
    {
        var random = new Random();

        // 顧客データ生成
        customers = Enumerable.Range(1, 1000)
            .Select(i => new Customer
            {
                Id = i,
                Name = $"顧客{i}",
                Email = $"customer{i}@example.com",
                RegistrationDate = DateTime.Now.AddDays(-random.Next(0, 1095)),
                Segment = new[] { "Premium", "Standard", "Basic" }[random.Next(3)],
                LifetimeValue = random.Next(10000, 500000),
                Region = new[] { "北海道", "関東", "関西", "九州" }[random.Next(4)]
            })
            .ToList();

        // 商品データ生成
        products = Enumerable.Range(1, 200)
            .Select(i => new Product
            {
                Id = i,
                Name = $"商品{i}",
                Category = new[] { "電子機器", "衣料品", "食品", "書籍", "家具" }[random.Next(5)],
                Price = random.Next(1000, 50000),
                Cost = random.Next(500, 30000),
                StockQuantity = random.Next(0, 1000),
                Rating = 1.0 + random.NextDouble() * 4.0
            })
            .ToList();

        // 売上データ生成
        sales = Enumerable.Range(1, 10000)
            .Select(i => new Sale
            {
                Id = i,
                CustomerId = random.Next(1, 1001),
                ProductId = random.Next(1, 201),
                SaleDate = DateTime.Now.AddDays(-random.Next(0, 365)),
                Quantity = random.Next(1, 10),
                UnitPrice = products[random.Next(200)].Price * (decimal)(0.8 + random.NextDouble() * 0.4),
                Discount = (decimal)(random.NextDouble() * 0.2)
            })
            .ToList();
    }

    // 1. 顧客セグメント別売上分析
    public CustomerSegmentAnalysis AnalyzeCustomerSegments()
    {
        var segmentAnalysis = customers
            .Join(sales, c => c.Id, s => s.CustomerId, (c, s) => new { Customer = c, Sale = s })
            .Join(products, cs => cs.Sale.ProductId, p => p.Id, (cs, p) => new { cs.Customer, cs.Sale, Product = p })
            .GroupBy(x => x.Customer.Segment)
            .Select(g => new SegmentMetrics
            {
                Segment = g.Key,
                CustomerCount = g.Select(x => x.Customer.Id).Distinct().Count(),
                TotalRevenue = g.Sum(x => x.Sale.Quantity * x.Sale.UnitPrice * (1 - x.Sale.Discount)),
                AverageOrderValue = g.Average(x => x.Sale.Quantity * x.Sale.UnitPrice * (1 - x.Sale.Discount)),
                PurchaseFrequency = (double)g.Count() / g.Select(x => x.Customer.Id).Distinct().Count(),
                TopProducts = g.GroupBy(x => x.Product.Name)
                              .OrderByDescending(pg => pg.Sum(x => x.Sale.Quantity))
                              .Take(5)
                              .Select(pg => new { Product = pg.Key, Quantity = pg.Sum(x => x.Sale.Quantity) })
                              .ToList(),
                SeasonalityPattern = g.GroupBy(x => x.Sale.SaleDate.Month)
                                    .ToDictionary(mg => mg.Key, mg => mg.Sum(x => x.Sale.Quantity * x.Sale.UnitPrice))
            })
            .OrderByDescending(s => s.TotalRevenue)
            .ToList();

        return new CustomerSegmentAnalysis
        {
            SegmentMetrics = segmentAnalysis,
            TotalRevenue = segmentAnalysis.Sum(s => s.TotalRevenue),
            GeneratedDate = DateTime.Now
        };
    }

    // 2. 商品別収益性分析
    public ProductProfitabilityAnalysis AnalyzeProductProfitability()
    {
        var productAnalysis = products
            .GroupJoin(sales, p => p.Id, s => s.ProductId, (p, salesGroup) => new { Product = p, Sales = salesGroup })
            .Select(pg => new ProductMetrics
            {
                Product = pg.Product,
                TotalRevenue = pg.Sales.Sum(s => s.Quantity * s.UnitPrice * (1 - s.Discount)),
                TotalCost = pg.Sales.Sum(s => s.Quantity * pg.Product.Cost),
                GrossProfit = pg.Sales.Sum(s => s.Quantity * s.UnitPrice * (1 - s.Discount)) - 
                             pg.Sales.Sum(s => s.Quantity * pg.Product.Cost),
                UnitsSold = pg.Sales.Sum(s => s.Quantity),
                ProfitMargin = pg.Sales.Any() ? 
                    (pg.Sales.Sum(s => s.Quantity * s.UnitPrice * (1 - s.Discount)) - 
                     pg.Sales.Sum(s => s.Quantity * pg.Product.Cost)) / 
                    pg.Sales.Sum(s => s.Quantity * s.UnitPrice * (1 - s.Discount)) : 0,
                InventoryTurnover = pg.Product.StockQuantity > 0 ? 
                    (double)pg.Sales.Sum(s => s.Quantity) / pg.Product.StockQuantity : 0
            })
            .Where(pm => pm.UnitsSold > 0)
            .OrderByDescending(pm => pm.GrossProfit)
            .ToList();

        // カテゴリ別分析
        var categoryAnalysis = productAnalysis
            .GroupBy(pm => pm.Product.Category)
            .Select(g => new CategoryMetrics
            {
                Category = g.Key,
                ProductCount = g.Count(),
                TotalRevenue = g.Sum(pm => pm.TotalRevenue),
                AverageMargin = g.Average(pm => pm.ProfitMargin),
                TopProduct = g.OrderByDescending(pm => pm.GrossProfit).First().Product.Name
            })
            .OrderByDescending(cm => cm.TotalRevenue)
            .ToList();

        return new ProductProfitabilityAnalysis
        {
            ProductMetrics = productAnalysis,
            CategoryMetrics = categoryAnalysis,
            TotalGrossProfit = productAnalysis.Sum(pm => pm.GrossProfit),
            AverageMargin = productAnalysis.Average(pm => pm.ProfitMargin)
        };
    }

    // 3. 地域別パフォーマンス比較
    public RegionalPerformanceAnalysis AnalyzeRegionalPerformance()
    {
        var regionalAnalysis = customers
            .Join(sales, c => c.Id, s => s.CustomerId, (c, s) => new { Customer = c, Sale = s })
            .GroupBy(cs => cs.Customer.Region)
            .Select(g => new RegionalMetrics
            {
                Region = g.Key,
                CustomerCount = g.Select(cs => cs.Customer.Id).Distinct().Count(),
                TotalRevenue = g.Sum(cs => cs.Sale.Quantity * cs.Sale.UnitPrice * (1 - cs.Sale.Discount)),
                AverageCustomerValue = g.GroupBy(cs => cs.Customer.Id)
                                      .Average(cg => cg.Sum(cs => cs.Sale.Quantity * cs.Sale.UnitPrice * (1 - cs.Sale.Discount))),
                OrderCount = g.Count(),
                MarketPenetration = (double)g.Select(cs => cs.Customer.Id).Distinct().Count() / 
                                   customers.Count(c => c.Region == g.Key),
                GrowthTrend = CalculateGrowthTrend(g.Key),
                TopPerformingCustomers = g.GroupBy(cs => new { cs.Customer.Id, cs.Customer.Name })
                                        .OrderByDescending(cg => cg.Sum(cs => cs.Sale.Quantity * cs.Sale.UnitPrice))
                                        .Take(5)
                                        .Select(cg => new { cg.Key.Name, 
                                            Revenue = cg.Sum(cs => cs.Sale.Quantity * cs.Sale.UnitPrice) })
                                        .ToList()
            })
            .OrderByDescending(rm => rm.TotalRevenue)
            .ToList();

        return new RegionalPerformanceAnalysis
        {
            RegionalMetrics = regionalAnalysis,
            BestPerformingRegion = regionalAnalysis.First().Region,
            TotalMarketSize = regionalAnalysis.Sum(rm => rm.TotalRevenue)
        };
    }

    // 4. 季節性トレンド分析
    public SeasonalityAnalysis AnalyzeSeasonality()
    {
        var monthlyTrends = sales
            .GroupBy(s => new { Year = s.SaleDate.Year, Month = s.SaleDate.Month })
            .Select(g => new MonthlyTrend
            {
                Year = g.Key.Year,
                Month = g.Key.Month,
                Revenue = g.Sum(s => s.Quantity * s.UnitPrice * (1 - s.Discount)),
                OrderCount = g.Count(),
                AverageOrderValue = g.Average(s => s.Quantity * s.UnitPrice * (1 - s.Discount))
            })
            .OrderBy(mt => mt.Year).ThenBy(mt => mt.Month)
            .ToList();

        var quarterlyTrends = monthlyTrends
            .GroupBy(mt => new { mt.Year, Quarter = (mt.Month - 1) / 3 + 1 })
            .Select(g => new QuarterlyTrend
            {
                Year = g.Key.Year,
                Quarter = g.Key.Quarter,
                Revenue = g.Sum(mt => mt.Revenue),
                GrowthRate = CalculateQuarterlyGrowthRate(g.Key.Year, g.Key.Quarter)
            })
            .ToList();

        var seasonalPatterns = products
            .Join(sales, p => p.Id, s => s.ProductId, (p, s) => new { Product = p, Sale = s })
            .GroupBy(ps => ps.Product.Category)
            .Select(g => new SeasonalPattern
            {
                Category = g.Key,
                PeakMonth = g.GroupBy(ps => ps.Sale.SaleDate.Month)
                            .OrderByDescending(mg => mg.Sum(ps => ps.Sale.Quantity))
                            .First().Key,
                SeasonalityIndex = CalculateSeasonalityIndex(g.Key)
            })
            .ToList();

        return new SeasonalityAnalysis
        {
            MonthlyTrends = monthlyTrends,
            QuarterlyTrends = quarterlyTrends,
            SeasonalPatterns = seasonalPatterns
        };
    }

    // 5. 顧客行動パターン分析
    public CustomerBehaviorAnalysis AnalyzeCustomerBehavior()
    {
        var behaviorPatterns = customers
            .GroupJoin(sales, c => c.Id, s => s.CustomerId, (c, salesGroup) => new { Customer = c, Sales = salesGroup.ToList() })
            .Select(cg => new CustomerBehaviorPattern
            {
                Customer = cg.Customer,
                PurchaseFrequency = cg.Sales.Count,
                AverageDaysBetweenPurchases = CalculateAverageDaysBetweenPurchases(cg.Sales),
                ProductDiversity = cg.Sales.Select(s => s.ProductId).Distinct().Count(),
                TotalSpent = cg.Sales.Sum(s => s.Quantity * s.UnitPrice * (1 - s.Discount)),
                PreferredCategories = cg.Sales
                    .Join(products, s => s.ProductId, p => p.Id, (s, p) => p.Category)
                    .GroupBy(cat => cat)
                    .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
                    .Take(3)
                    .Select(g => g.Key)
                    .ToList(),
                Pricesensitivity = CalculatePriceSensitivity(cg.Sales),
                LoyaltyScore = CalculateLoyaltyScore(cg.Customer, cg.Sales),
                ChurnRisk = CalculateChurnRisk(cg.Customer, cg.Sales)
            })
            .Where(bp => bp.PurchaseFrequency > 0)
            .ToList();

        var segmentBehaviors = behaviorPatterns
            .GroupBy(bp => bp.Customer.Segment)
            .Select(g => new SegmentBehavior
            {
                Segment = g.Key,
                AveragePurchaseFrequency = g.Average(bp => bp.PurchaseFrequency),
                AverageProductDiversity = g.Average(bp => bp.ProductDiversity),
                AverageLoyaltyScore = g.Average(bp => bp.LoyaltyScore),
                HighRiskCustomers = g.Count(bp => bp.ChurnRisk > 0.7)
            })
            .ToList();

        return new CustomerBehaviorAnalysis
        {
            BehaviorPatterns = behaviorPatterns,
            SegmentBehaviors = segmentBehaviors,
            HighValueCustomers = behaviorPatterns
                .OrderByDescending(bp => bp.TotalSpent)
                .Take(50)
                .ToList(),
            AtRiskCustomers = behaviorPatterns
                .Where(bp => bp.ChurnRisk > 0.7)
                .OrderByDescending(bp => bp.TotalSpent)
                .ToList()
        };
    }

    // 補助メソッド
    private double CalculateGrowthTrend(string region)
    {
        // 地域別成長トレンドの計算（簡略化）
        return 0.15; // ダミー値
    }

    private double CalculateQuarterlyGrowthRate(int year, int quarter)
    {
        // 四半期成長率の計算（簡略化）
        return 0.08; // ダミー値
    }

    private double CalculateSeasonalityIndex(string category)
    {
        // 季節性指数の計算（簡略化）
        return category switch
        {
            "衣料品" => 1.3,
            "電子機器" => 0.9,
            _ => 1.0
        };
    }

    private double CalculateAverageDaysBetweenPurchases(List<Sale> sales)
    {
        if (sales.Count <= 1) return 0;

        var sortedDates = sales.OrderBy(s => s.SaleDate).Select(s => s.SaleDate).ToList();
        var intervals = sortedDates.Zip(sortedDates.Skip(1), (first, second) => (second - first).Days);
        return intervals.Any() ? intervals.Average() : 0;
    }

    private double CalculatePriceSensitivity(List<Sale> sales)
    {
        // 価格感応度の計算（割引の平均利用率）
        return sales.Any() ? sales.Average(s => (double)s.Discount) : 0;
    }

    private double CalculateLoyaltyScore(Customer customer, List<Sale> sales)
    {
        var daysSinceRegistration = (DateTime.Now - customer.RegistrationDate).Days;
        var purchaseDays = sales.Select(s => s.SaleDate.Date).Distinct().Count();
        var loyaltyBase = daysSinceRegistration > 0 ? (double)purchaseDays / daysSinceRegistration : 0;

        // 購入頻度と継続期間を考慮
        var frequencyBonus = Math.Min(sales.Count / 10.0, 1.0);
        return Math.Min(loyaltyBase + frequencyBonus, 1.0);
    }

    private double CalculateChurnRisk(Customer customer, List<Sale> sales)
    {
        if (!sales.Any()) return 1.0;

        var daysSinceLastPurchase = (DateTime.Now - sales.Max(s => s.SaleDate)).Days;
        var averageDaysBetweenPurchases = CalculateAverageDaysBetweenPurchases(sales);

        if (averageDaysBetweenPurchases == 0) return 0.5;

        var riskRatio = daysSinceLastPurchase / averageDaysBetweenPurchases;
        return Math.Min(riskRatio / 3.0, 1.0); // 平均間隔の3倍以上で高リスク
    }
}

public class LinqPerformanceBenchmark
{
    public static void RunBenchmarkSuite()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("=== LINQ パフォーマンステストスイート ===\n");

        var testData = GenerateTestData(100_000);

        // 1. フィルタリング操作のベンチマーク
        BenchmarkFilteringOperations(testData);

        // 2. 集約操作のベンチマーク
        BenchmarkAggregationOperations(testData);

        // 3. 結合操作のベンチマーク
        BenchmarkJoinOperations(testData);

        // 4. カスタム拡張メソッドのベンチマーク
        BenchmarkCustomExtensions(testData);
    }

    private static List<TestEntity> GenerateTestData(int count)
    {
        var random = new Random();
        return Enumerable.Range(1, count)
            .Select(i => new TestEntity
            {
                Id = i,
                Value = random.Next(1, 1000),
                Category = $"Category{random.Next(1, 11)}",
                IsActive = random.NextDouble() > 0.3,
                CreatedDate = DateTime.Now.AddDays(-random.Next(0, 365))
            })
            .ToList();
    }

    private static void BenchmarkFilteringOperations(List<TestEntity> data)
    {
        Console.WriteLine("--- フィルタリング操作ベンチマーク ---");

        var stopwatch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();

        // Where with multiple conditions
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var result1 = data.Where(x => x.IsActive && x.Value > 500 && x.Category.StartsWith("Category1")).ToList();
        stopwatch.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"複数条件Where: {stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms ({result1.Count} 件)");

        // Where with WhereIf extension
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var result2 = data
            .WhereIf(true, x => x.IsActive)
            .WhereIf(true, x => x.Value > 500)
            .WhereIf(true, x => x.Category.StartsWith("Category1"))
            .ToList();
        stopwatch.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"WhereIf拡張メソッド: {stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms ({result2.Count} 件)");

        // Take vs First
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var result3 = data.Where(x => x.Value > 900).Take(1).ToList();
        stopwatch.Stop();
        var takeTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;

        stopwatch.Restart();
        var result4 = data.Where(x => x.Value > 900).FirstOrDefault();
        stopwatch.Stop();
        var firstTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;

        Console.WriteLine($"Take(1): {takeTime}ms vs FirstOrDefault: {firstTime}ms");
        Console.WriteLine();
    }

    private static void BenchmarkAggregationOperations(List<TestEntity> data)
    {
        Console.WriteLine("--- 集約操作ベンチマーク ---");

        var stopwatch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();

        // Multiple aggregations - inefficient
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var count1 = data.Count();
        var sum1 = data.Sum(x => x.Value);
        var avg1 = data.Average(x => x.Value);
        var max1 = data.Max(x => x.Value);
        stopwatch.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"個別集約操作: {stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms");

        // Single pass aggregation - efficient
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var stats = data.GetStatistics(x => x.Value);
        stopwatch.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"一括統計取得: {stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms");

        Console.WriteLine($"結果: Count={stats.Count}, Sum={stats.Sum}, Avg={stats.Average:F2}, Max={stats.Max}");
        Console.WriteLine();
    }

    private static void BenchmarkJoinOperations(List<TestEntity> data)
    {
        Console.WriteLine("--- 結合操作ベンチマーク ---");

        var categories = data.Select(x => x.Category).Distinct()
            .Select(cat => new { Category = cat, Description = $"Description for {cat}" })
            .ToList();

        var stopwatch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();

        // LINQ Join
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var joined1 = data.Join(categories, 
            d => d.Category, 
            c => c.Category, 
            (d, c) => new { d.Id, d.Value, c.Description })
            .ToList();
        stopwatch.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"LINQ Join: {stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms ({joined1.Count} 件)");

        // Dictionary lookup (faster for large datasets)
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var categoryDict = categories.ToDictionary(c => c.Category, c => c.Description);
        var joined2 = data.Select(d => new 
        { 
            d.Id, 
            d.Value, 
            Description = categoryDict.TryGetValue(d.Category, out var desc) ? desc : "Unknown" 
        }).ToList();
        stopwatch.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"Dictionary Lookup: {stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms ({joined2.Count} 件)");
        Console.WriteLine();
    }

    private static void BenchmarkCustomExtensions(List<TestEntity> data)
    {
        Console.WriteLine("--- カスタム拡張メソッドベンチマーク ---");

        var stopwatch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();

        // Batch processing
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var batches = data.Batch(1000).ToList();
        stopwatch.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"Batch処理 (1000件ずつ): {stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms ({batches.Count} バッチ)");

        // DistinctBy
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var distinct1 = data.DistinctBy(x => x.Category).ToList();
        stopwatch.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"DistinctBy: {stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms ({distinct1.Count} 件)");

        // Partition
        stopwatch.Restart();
        var (active, inactive) = data.PartitionBy(x => x.IsActive);
        var activeCount = active.Count();
        var inactiveCount = inactive.Count();
        stopwatch.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"PartitionBy: {stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms (Active: {activeCount}, Inactive: {inactiveCount})");
        Console.WriteLine();
    }

    public class TestEntity
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public int Value { get; set; }
        public string Category { get; set; }
        public bool IsActive { get; set; }
        public DateTime CreatedDate { get; set; }
    }
}

docs.text:

チーム開発での注意点 - 一貫性: プロジェクト内でのLINQ使用方針の統一 - ドキュメント: カスタム拡張メソッドの仕様明記 - テスト: 複雑なLINQクエリの単体テスト実装 - レビュー: パフォーマンス影響の検証

学習リソース - Microsoft公式ドキュメント - パフォーマンスベンチマークツール - オープンソースプロジェクトの実装例
